vtts.releaseNotes: New End of chapter sleep timer: vTTS finishes the chapter you are listening to, then stops. Voice studio now coaches you while you record, pointing out clipping, a voice that is too quiet or a noisy room right away. More memory headroom for the high-quality voices on iPhone and iPad. Stability and performance improvements.
vtts.description:
Make time for the books you love, even when your eyes need a break. vTTS reads books and text aloud on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with voices built into the app and ready to use offline.

YOUR OWN VOICE
Record about 20 seconds in the voice studio and listen to books in a voice made from yours. The studio coaches you as you record, pointing out clipping, a voice that is too quiet or a noisy room. Your recording is processed on your device and deleted once the voice is created.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
• Voices and interface in 17 languages, including English and Vietnamese.
• Paste text or import EPUB, PDF, DOCX, TXT and other supported formats.
• Follow the highlighted passage or tap a sentence to listen from there.
• Adjust speed while listening, add background music and set a sleep timer.
• Resume at your saved position, with a separate language, voice and speed for each book.

KEEP WHAT MATTERS
• Search within books, add bookmarks and save notes.
• Track listening time, daily goals, streaks and achievements.
• Back up your library to a file and restore it when needed.
• Choose what to sync with iCloud: activity and achievements, books and reading positions, drafts, history and your pronunciation dictionary.
• Export M4A, MP3, AAC or WAV audio, or an M4B audiobook with chapters.

TRANSLATE AND LISTEN
Translate text and books on your device. A translated book is saved as a new copy, preserving the original and opening in the target language. Requires iOS/iPadOS 18 or macOS 15 or later; availability depends on the language pair. The system may need to download language data the first time.

Speech is generated on your device without a cloud speech service. The optional LAN server is off by default and protected by an access token. On iPhone and iPad, the app must stay in the foreground to serve requests.

FREE TO TRY
The free version includes usage limits. vTTS Premium is an optional one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited listening, library storage and audio exports, plus LAN hosting. No subscription. See the in-app comparison for details.

padcodeai.trackName: Pad Code AI: Code Editor & IDE
padcodeai.releaseNotes:
Pad Code AI 3.0 brings a real Python debugger, keeps your work safe and makes the AI agent smarter.

• Debug Python like on a desktop: watch expressions, conditional breakpoints, logpoints that print instead of stopping, Run to Cursor, and variables that open to show what lists, dicts and objects hold.
• Files a program writes, such as a CSV report or a chart, are listed when it ends so you can review them and save them to your project.
• Never lose an edit: if another app, window or Git changed a file while you were editing, Pad Code AI asks which version to keep instead of overwriting it.
• Pick up where you left off: your last project reopens with its tabs, split editor and unsaved edits, even after the app was closed.
• Server files: saves made offline survive closing the app and upload when the server is back. A file changed on the server is never overwritten without asking, and the status bar shows each upload.
• A smarter agent: it lists and searches your whole project and keeps the goal of long conversations in mind.
• Safer skills: skills that come with a downloaded project stay off until you trust them, and private files such as .env and keys are never sent to the AI.
• Clone any of your GitHub repositories, not just the first 100.
• A brighter new app icon.
• npm scripts run from the Dependencies panel, plus many smaller fixes.
padcodeai.description:
Pad Code AI turns your iPad and iPhone into a complete coding studio: an editor, on-device runtimes, a debugger, a terminal, Git and an AI that builds with you.

VIBE CODING
Describe the app or change you want in your own words. The AI plans it, writes the files and can run the code to check its work. Choose how much it may do — Ask, Plan, Edit or Auto — and review or undo every change with before-and-after diffs. It also works as an everyday chat for questions, learning and ideas.

AI YOUR WAY
Use Apple Intelligence on supported devices for private, on-device help, including agent tasks. Or connect your own keys for optional third-party providers, save several models and switch in one tap. Attach files, photos and project context; you decide what is shared. You can also download open models such as Qwen and Gemma and use them offline, so nothing leaves your device.

WRITE, RUN AND DEBUG
Run C, C++, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Ruby, PHP, Lua and SQLite on your device with bundled compilers and interpreters, using input, arguments and project files. Debug Python with breakpoints, conditions, logpoints, watch expressions and Run to Cursor, and open lists, dicts and objects to see what they hold. Files your programs write are listed when they finish, ready to review and save. Plot with matplotlib, use packages such as NumPy and pandas, preview HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Markdown and SVG, typeset LaTeX, and print or save any preview as PDF.

YOUR WORK IS SAFE
A save never silently replaces a change made by another app, window or Git: Pad Code AI asks which version to keep. Your last project reopens with its tabs, split editor and unsaved edits, and server files saved offline upload when the connection is back.

SERVERS AND TERMINAL
Connect to your servers over SSH with a full terminal — colors, vim, htop and tmux — and browse and edit their files over SFTP. The local terminal is a shell for your project: ls, cd, grep, pipes and redirection, plus python3, node, gcc and npm.

A REAL EDITOR
Syntax highlighting, code completion, go to definition, find references, rename, project-wide search and replace, folding, snippets and a split editor. Images, video, audio and PDF files open in native previews.

GIT BUILT IN
Clone over HTTPS from GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and more. Review diffs, commit, branch, stash, push and pull. Sign in to GitHub to browse and clone your repositories, private ones included.

MADE FOR IPAD, GREAT ON IPHONE
Multiple windows, menus and keyboard shortcuts on iPad, and a compact layout that shows more code on iPhone. Open projects from Spotlight, Siri and Shortcuts. Available in 20 languages.

The AI agent and Vibe Coding are free. Try the split editor and project-wide replace free each day; a one-time purchase removes their daily limits.

On-device AI requires a compatible device with Apple Intelligence enabled. Third-party AI requires your own credentials and an internet connection; availability varies by region. Code runs offline; Git, package downloads and remote AI need internet. Swift and other unsupported languages are editing-only. Downloaded models run on supported devices with enough memory and storage.

Support: https://phamhungtien.com/PadCodeAI

padnotesai.releaseNotes:
• Tape: lay as many strips as you like in a row. Each one stays on the page and peels back on its own.
• New pen picker: see every ink as a real stroke, choose fine, medium or thick in one tap, and add the pen to My Pens.
• Settings are organized into clear sections, shown side by side on iPad and Mac.
• The AI assistant reads like a document: wider answers, one-tap copy, insert, share and ask again, and a status that shows what it is doing.
• Voice recordings: transcripts with punctuation, your notebook's own terms recognized, and the speech language follows your device.
• Library: full notebook names and when each one was last edited.
padnotesai.description:
Handwrite, type, annotate PDFs and study in one notebook on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Pad Notes AI pairs a natural Apple Pencil experience with memorization tape and an AI assistant that works from your own notes.

WRITE AND CREATE
Write with Apple Pencil on compatible iPads or draw with touch. Adjust ink and stroke size, highlight, add text and images, and hold a stroke to turn it into an editable shape. Erase whole strokes or just part of them.

STUDY WITH MEMORIZATION TAPE
Cover definitions, formulas or answers with straight, box or freehand tape in eight patterns and colors. Try to recall them, then tap the tape to peel it back. Cover All and Reveal All turn any page into a quick self-test.

MAKE EACH NOTEBOOK YOURS
Choose from 15 cover styles, 19 page templates and 12 paper colors. Use ruled, dotted, grid, Cornell, planner, music and reading journal pages. Organize notebooks in folders, pin favorites, search your notes, and import or export PDFs.

WORK WITH YOUR NOTES
Record audio, use transcription and translation, and ask the assistant to summarize, explain or create study questions from selected pages. Apple on-device AI requires a supported device with Apple Intelligence available. Online AI requires your own provider API key and an internet connection. The basic offline mode extracts text and keywords using rules.

Start with up to 20 notebooks for free. A one-time lifetime purchase unlocks unlimited notebooks. iCloud sync uses your device's Apple Account and requires iCloud to be available.

mynasmanager.releaseNotes:
• Refreshed design with clearer cards, charts and management screens
• 8 new languages: Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Russian, Indonesian, Hindi, Arabic and Traditional Chinese
• File Station: select several items to rename, copy, move or delete
• Automatic two-factor prompt at sign-in
• Hyper Backup jobs and package start/stop
• iPad menu bar commands and keyboard shortcuts
• Faster refreshes and large folders, plus many fixes
mynasmanager.description:
My NAS Manager puts your Synology NAS in your pocket. Check its health, work with your files and manage downloads from iPhone and iPad.

OVERVIEW
• Live CPU, memory, network and temperature with realtime charts
• Top processes, system information and recent activity

FILE STATION
• Browse shared folders and search the current folder
• Upload and download with progress, retry and cancel
• Rename, copy, move and delete one item or many
• Preview files and create share links

STORAGE
• Storage pools, volumes and drives with usage and health
• Drive temperature and S.M.A.R.T. status

DOWNLOAD STATION
• Add HTTP, FTP or magnet links
• Pause, resume, delete and filter tasks

MANAGEMENT
• Start or stop installed packages
• Security Advisor results, network interfaces and system logs
• Run Hyper Backup jobs and restart DSM

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Sidebar layout, menu bar commands and keyboard shortcuts on iPad
• Dark Mode, Dynamic Type and 15 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The app connects only to the NAS you enter. No accounts, ads or tracking. Your session is kept in the iOS Keychain. Two-factor authentication and HTTPS are supported.

Available features depend on your DSM version, installed packages and account permissions. SSH settings require the one-time Lifetime purchase.

Synology and DSM are trademarks of Synology Inc. My NAS Manager is not affiliated with Synology.

lunarv.releaseNotes:
LunarV 2.1 — a fresh look, cleaner and faster.
• New app icon: a golden crescent and stars that stay crisp in every mode.
• New Good Day Finder for weddings, groundbreaking, openings, moving, travel and signing — skipping traditional days to avoid and days that clash with your age.
• Tools in a grid with a short description each.
• Redesigned world clocks: large time, day/night cues, live every minute.
• iPad: two-column Today screen. Apple Vision Pro: clearer buttons and labels.
• Performance improvements across the app and widgets.
lunarv.description:
LunarV is a clear, accurate Vietnamese lunar calendar and almanac (âm lịch) for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Vision Pro. See lunar dates and lucky hours, pick good days, and remember the occasions that matter to your family — all computed on device, no account needed.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• Lunar date, Can Chi for day, month and year, solar term, zodiac and moon phase.
• Day score, next auspicious hour and today's events.
• Details: five elements, clashing ages, harmony groups, day officer, and what to do or avoid.

GOOD DAY FINDER (NEW)
• Find auspicious days in the next 30, 60 or 90 days for weddings, groundbreaking, openings, moving home, travel and signing.
• Automatically skips Tam nương and Nguyệt kỵ days, unsuitable day officers and — with a profile — days that clash with your age.

SOLAR & LUNAR MONTH
• A month grid with Gregorian and lunar dates side by side, holidays and notes.
• Convert dates and search holidays, events and prayers in seconds.
• Includes the Chinese calendar (1901–2100).

FAMILY REMINDERS
• Save memorial anniversaries, birthdays and full-moon days by lunar or solar date, repeating yearly, monthly or weekly.
• Get reminded in advance; optionally sync to Apple Calendar.

CULTURAL TOOLS
Date converter, good day finder, prayer library, date journal, first-visitor finder, yearly stars, age compatibility, Lu Ban ruler, birth element wheel, feng shui compass and Kongming oracle.

WIDGETS, MENU BAR AND MORE
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and desktop widgets.
• On Mac, the lunar date lives in your menu bar.
• Siri Shortcuts, Spotlight and live world clocks.
• Vietnamese, English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese; Dynamic Type and VoiceOver.

LUNARV PREMIUM
The calendar, date conversion, search and tools remain free. The free version lets you create 20 family occasions and 100 date notes. Premium is a one-time lifetime purchase with no subscription, unlocking unlimited family occasions and date notes. Restore purchases with your Apple Account.

Feng shui, prayer and good-day content is provided as cultural reference.

lunarblock.releaseNotes:
Version 1.0.5 brings a more polished Lunar Block experience:

• Improved rotation behavior near walls and the floor
• Refined menus, buttons, score panels, and settings controls
• Improved saved-run handling after completed games
• Added clearer English and Vietnamese time labels
• Improved gameplay presentation, haptics, and interaction feedback
• Refined support for iPhone, iPad, and Mac
lunarblock.description:
Lunar Block transforms the classic falling-block puzzle into a cinematic 3D orbital arena for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Stack, rotate, hold, and drop crystal blocks to complete rows and build your highest score. Master responsive controls, use the ghost piece to plan each move, and chain combos, four-line clears, back-to-back clears, and Perfect Clears.

Choose your challenge:

• Marathon: survive as long as possible
• Sprint: clear 40 lines as fast as you can
• Ultra: score as much as possible in 120 seconds

Features:

• Smooth 3D playfield with dynamic lighting and impact effects
• Seven-piece bag, hold slot, next preview, and ghost piece
• Wall kicks and responsive lock-delay controls
• Touch gestures, keyboard, on-screen controls, and game controller support
• Haptic feedback, synthesized sound effects, and optional enhanced effects
• Personal records, XP ranks, achievements, and Game Center leaderboards
• English and Vietnamese localization
• Automatic saved-run support across sessions

Play comfortably on iPhone, iPad, or Mac with controls adapted to each platform. Every drop changes the shape of your run. Stay focused, clear the board, and reach the next lunar rank.
